To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the relationship between passion and psychological adjustment depends on the level of competition.
(a) harmonious and obsessive passion are differentially related to psychological adjustment and (b) the nature of the passion- adjustment relation is contingent on the environment.

(a) being selected for a team in the most competitive league is associated with greater psychological adjustment and (b) the association between playing in the most competitive leagues and psychological adjustment is stronger among athletes with a harmonious passion for hockey.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role played by the environment in the relationship between passion and psychological adjustment.
the role of passion in the person–environment (P–E) fit process and its implications for psychological adjustment.
how the fit between passion and the environment affects psychological adjustment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
harmonious passion is more adaptive than obsessive passion, especially in less competitive environments.
a harmonious passion fits better with a less competitive environment and an obsessive passion fits better with highly competitive environments.
a harmonious passion in a less competitive environment leads to higher psychological adjustment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
harmonious athletes are more likely to be psychologically well-adjusted, and that this is especially true when playing in highly competitive environments.
harmonious passion is a positive psychological state and is associated with better psychological adjustment than is obsessive passion.
a fit between one’s passion and the environment in which it is expressed is associated with higher psychological adjustment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relationship between passion and psychological adjustment depends on the fit between the person and the environment.
the relationship between passion and psychological adjustment is moderated by person–environment fit.
it is important for athletes to be aware of the potential negative consequences of obsessive passion, especially in a competitive environment.
